# Lepide Design System

> The design system of the Lepide console: design tokens (light, dark, high contrast), a framework-free stylesheet (@lepide/ds-css), a React 18 component kit (@lepide/ds-react) and one documentation page per component. Calm, airy enterprise look: pale canvas, frosted-glass sidebar, white 20 px cards, Manrope type, pill controls, one brand colour (Lepide blue #1c4599).

Build UI from the components, use only tokens for values, one primary button per view, and follow the checklist in DESIGN.md §8. The full text of everything below is in [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

## Spec

- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): the complete spec — setup, look, tokens, every component, shell markup, page patterns, accessibility, do/don't, starter page, checklist
- [AI rules](ai/rules.md): the always/never rules for AI coding tools

## Machine-readable

- [docs/components.json](docs/components.json): every component with import path, props, defaults, CSS classes, tokens and guidance
- [tokens/build/json/tokens.json](tokens/build/json/tokens.json): every token with CSS name, type, description and value per theme
- [tokens/build/css/tokens.css](tokens/build/css/tokens.css): the tokens as CSS custom properties

## Components

- [Providers](docs/components/providers.md): App-root setup. LepideProvider plugs in your router's link; ThemeProvider stores the light, dark or hc theme and applies it as <html data-theme>. Mount ToastProvider and TooltipHost once beside them. (LepideProvider, ThemeProvider)
- [Button](docs/components/button.md): Pill-shaped buttons for actions. One blue primary per view, rightmost; everything else secondary, ghost or danger. (Button, IconButton)
- [Checkbox](docs/components/checkbox.md): 16 px checkbox with a label for independent on/off choices in forms, lists and table selection; supports an indeterminate state. (Checkbox)
- [Date range picker](docs/components/date-range-picker.md): Ghost-button popover with date presets (Today … Last Month) and a Custom Range month calendar; the change is applied only on Apply. (DateRangePicker, Calendar)
- [Dropdown](docs/components/dropdown.md): Select-only combobox that replaces the native select — 46 px trigger, floating rounded panel, brand tint and check on the selected row, full keyboard support. (Dropdown, SelectField, FloatingPop)
- [File upload](docs/components/file-upload.md): Dashed drop zone for choosing or dropping one file; once a file is set it turns into a file card with name, size and a remove button. (FileUpload)
- [Pill input](docs/components/pill-input.md): 40 px pill-shaped text input for toolbars and searches, with an optional leading icon; SearchField is the soft-filled search variant. (PillInput, SearchField)
- [Radio group](docs/components/radio-group.md): A set of 36 px radio option rows for choosing exactly one value; stacked by default or wrapped in a row. (RadioGroup)
- [Search select](docs/components/search-select.md): Labelled select fields for long lists — SearchSelect picks one value with a search box past 8 options; MultiSelect picks several with checkboxes and an optional Select All. (SearchSelect, MultiSelect)
- [Setting row](docs/components/setting-row.md): A settings list row with a title and help text on the left and a control (usually a Toggle) on the right, separated by hairlines. (SettingRow)
- [Text field](docs/components/text-field.md): Labelled form fields for dialogs and page forms — 46 px soft-filled controls with a label, optional note, help text and inline error. (Field, TextField, PasswordField, NumberField, TextAreaField)
- [Tile picker](docs/components/tile-picker.md): A grid of selectable tiles (icon or logo, title, one-line description) for choosing a type or source — single choice by default, or several with multiple. (TilePicker)
- [Toggle](docs/components/toggle.md): 38 × 22 on/off switch for settings that take effect immediately; always has an accessible label. (Toggle)
- [Wizard card](docs/components/wizard-card.md): Full-page multi-step form — a step indicator above a card holding one step's fields, with Back, Cancel and Next/Finish in the footer. (WizardCard)
- [Menu](docs/components/menu.md): A trigger plus an anchored popover menu of actions (.pop), with icons, separators, selected and danger items, and disabled items that explain why. (Menu)
- [PageHeader](docs/components/page-header.md): The top of every page — optional breadcrumbs, eyebrow, the page title (h2), an optional chip and description, and the page actions at the right. (PageHeader)
- [Section nav](docs/components/section-nav.md): Left-hand section navigation for settings-style pages, with a built-in dropdown that replaces it under 860 px. The current section gets the selected finish. (SectionNav)
- [Segmented](docs/components/segmented.md): Pill-shaped segmented control that switches between two to five sibling views (tabs mode) or data filters (pressed mode). (Segmented)
- [Tree](docs/components/tree.md): Folder / report tree for a hub page — top-level folders with counts, expandable groups and nested items. The current row gets the selected finish. (Tree)
- [VerticalTabs](docs/components/vertical-tabs.md): A vertical list of section buttons for the left column of settings-style dialogs; the current section gets the selected finish. (VerticalTabs)
- [Avatar](docs/components/avatar.md): Round initials avatar with a tint picked from the name, and Person, an avatar plus name and optional detail on one line. (Avatar, Person)
- [Card](docs/components/card.md): White rounded containers. Card for content panels, SetCard for settings sections with head, body and footer, KeyValues for read-only field tiles. (Card, SetCard, KeyValues)
- [Chip](docs/components/chip.md): Small read-only pills. Chip labels a thing, ToneTag shows a status with a dot and text, Counter shows a number. (Chip, ToneTag, Counter)
- [Icon](docs/components/icon.md): Thin Lucide-style line icons (1.6 stroke, currentColor), the product module glyphs, and the Lepide mark in its white tile. (Icon, ModuleIcon, BrandMark, MARK_URL)
- [Banner](docs/components/banner.md): Inline tinted message strip with a tone icon, text, an optional action and an optional dismiss button — for persistent notices inside a page, card or dialog. (Banner)
- [EmptyState](docs/components/empty-state.md): Centred block on a dotted field with an icon tile, a title, an optional message and an action — for empty lists, no results and load errors. (EmptyState)
- [Loading](docs/components/loading.md): Loading feedback — shimmering skeleton table rows, a centred page spinner, and a determinate or indeterminate progress bar. (SkeletonRows, PageLoader, ProgressBar)
- [Toast](docs/components/toast.md): Notifications from one call, toast({...}). They show as a card stack in the bottom-right corner, or as a nudge callout beside the control the user just clicked when an error or warning answers that click. (ToastProvider, useToast)
- [Drawer](docs/components/drawer.md): Floating side panel that slides in from the right over a scrim (Drawer), and the non-modal sticky panel beside a list (DetailPanel). (Drawer, DetailPanel)
- [Modal](docs/components/modal.md): Centred dialog with icon-tile head, scrolling form body and a footer of buttons; ConfirmDialog for yes/no questions; Steps for multi-step progress. (Modal, ConfirmDialog, Steps)
- [Tooltip](docs/components/tooltip.md): One floating tooltip for the whole app. Mount TooltipHost once; any element with data-tip, and every icon-only button with an aria-label, shows its label on hover or keyboard focus. (TooltipHost)
- [Chart](docs/components/chart.md): Highcharts-based charts in the Lepide Design System theme — one Chart component with a kind per product chart type (columns, stacked, bars, areas, lines, donuts, gauges, rings, bubbles), plus a borderless Sparkline. Imported from '@lepide/ds-react/charts'. (Chart, Sparkline)
- [Data table](docs/components/data-table.md): Table card with title and count, sortable headers, an optional column filter row, checkbox selection, row open and row actions, client-side paging, skeleton loading and empty states, and a sticky first column. (DataTable, Pager)
- [KPI card](docs/components/kpi-card.md): Stat card with a label, a large value that counts up once, an optional delta chip, a foot line and a full-bleed sparkline. Imported from '@lepide/ds-react/charts'. (KpiCard)
